title: Greg Fitzsimmons: You Know Me
overview: Greg’s new stand-up comedy special, Greg Fitzsimmons: You Know Me, was recorded on November 18, 2023 at The Comedy Mothership in Austin, TX. After 35 years performing stand-up, You Know Me, finds Greg hilariously reflecting on 34 years of sobriety, sex with a 57-year-old woman, convincing your children that you’re cool, and combating loneliness on the road.  And he realizes, he’s happy where he is.
